SCORPIOUS_PIPBOY.Title: Pip-Boy
SCORPIOUS_PIPBOY.Settings.Layout.Name: Pip-Boy Layout
SCORPIOUS_PIPBOY.Settings.Layout.Hint: The casing the Pip-Boy is drawn in. Original is the wrist unit. The Lonestar Edition is a wide unit worn across the forearm: a lever picks the tab, a meter reads your character's radiation, and a readout bay sits under the screen. Frame color, size, scanlines and the boot screen apply to both.
SCORPIOUS_PIPBOY.Settings.GeigerClicks.H: Lonestar Edition only: the radiation meter clicks as it counts, faster the more rads your character has. Needs Pip-Boy Sounds on; heard only by you.
SCORPIOUS_PIPBOY.Settings.FrameColor.Hin: The casing colour used for the Pip-Boy window. The screen tint follows the frame.
SCORPIOUS_PIPBOY.Settings.Scanlines.Name: CRT Scanlines
SCORPIOUS_PIPBOY.Settings.Scanlines.Hint: Show the CRT scanline overlay on the Pip-Boy screen. Disable if the scanlines make text hard to read.
SCORPIOUS_PIPBOY.TileShowOnMapHint: Draw this tile on the Pip-Boy's MAP tab (both the World and Local views of this scene).
